Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover accent="true"><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mover accent="true"><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mover accent="true"><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mover accent="true"><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mi> </mi><mover accent="true"><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mover accent="true"><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>-</mo><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced><mover accent="true"><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mover accent="true"><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover accent="true"><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mover accent="true"><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mover accent="true"><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced><mover accent="true"><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> be three vectors such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover accent="true"><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mover accent="true"><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is perpendicular to <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>.</mo></math> Then a possible value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi> </mi><mi>λ</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi> </mi><msub><mi>λ</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> is
